product_one_liner.value: iVoyant’s Koodisi is an enterprise integration platform that connects business systems and automates workflows for IT, integration, and operations teams.

pricing_page.notes: Koodisi publishes one Enterprise plan with custom quotes rather than numerical prices.

named_customers.notes: The capability statement identifies inventory/pricing work for NAPA and CRM, case-management, and analytics work for AT&T Cricket Wireless.

employee_band.notes: Company-size band reported on iVoyant’s LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored technical posts cover PlatformNX copilot routing and building a Firebase/AI application; these appear within the general company blog.

public_docs.notes: Public Koodisi documentation includes multiple articles covering activities, AI-assisted development, and administration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI/ML Engineer in Bangalore is listed among current openings and has an application page.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product documentation, the AI user guide, AI governance documentation, security FAQ, privacy policy, and technical blog. No underlying provider was confirmed as actually used; GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude appear only as illustrative examples.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits are described as closed and approved, but the certificates have not yet been issued; excluded under the in-progress rule. No qualifying HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS claim was found.

last_funding.notes: The company profile reports no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding rounds are reported.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists five technical/design openings and no SDR, BDR, or Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 release introduced Agent Studio for building AI agents and expanded AI-assisted workflow building, deployment, and testing.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying join or departure was found for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09 after reviewing the small public team. Sonya Beredimas joined in 2018, and Basanth Gowda was already identified as Chief Architect before the window; complete role-start dates are not published.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A closed SDR posting requests experience with Apollo or a similar prospecting tool and HubSpot or another CRM; this is a hiring-stack signal, not definitive confirmation of deployment.
